meta.title: Solano Superior Court appointed-counsel billing guidelines (rev 2025-11-18)
meta.licence: No licence stated. Government/public-institution publication posted on the open web; used only as a public document for internal evaluation, not redistributed.
meta.pii_note: Public document from an agency or court; counts only, no matched text recorded. Hits: email 1, street_address 2, case_party_marker 2. Hits are agency contact details, addresses and generic role words, not private individuals.

pii_scan.disposition: Business and agency contact details only; no private-person data expected. Safe for local evaluation use.

rules.paraphrase: Fixed hourly attorney rate of 95 dollars for work after 1 May 2023 and 108 dollars after 9 January 2025.
Only attorney work may be billed; support staff time is not compensated.
Actual time only, rounded up to the nearest tenth of an hour.
Double or multiple billing for one court appearance across cases is not tolerated.
No bundling of services; each task is itemised.

keywords: travel to and from place of business to court
params.allowed: actual travel to meet a party outside court

rules.paraphrase: Travel between place of business and court is not reimbursable.
Only court filing fees and mandatory public agency fees are reimbursed; fees cover all other expenses.
One claim monthly per case; completed work within 30 days and no later than 60 days.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: The claim packet must include the signed vendor claim form, order and FL-323.
Fiscal-year-end invoices are submitted within twenty days after June 30.
